prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1265; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head impact and subsequent symptoms consistent with concussion. The mechanism and force of the collision are well matched to the injury described. Over the course of 25 visits, the patient received a structured program of symptom monitoring, cognitive rest guidance, vestibular and oculomotor exercises, and gradual return-to-activity planning. Treatment followed a typical clinical progression, with visit frequency and intensity tapering as symptoms improved. Examination findings were mixed: several measures, including balance and eye-tracking assessments, supported the diagnosis, while other neurological screening tests returned normal results. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known to this provider. Billing records show two similar service charges on the same date of service, which are currently under routine review. Patient is discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
